items.title: W(2;3,21) = 416 - a van der Waerden number conjectured by Kullmann in 2010, now proved with a Lean 4 kernel-checked proof [R]
items.title_zh: Lean 4 内核检验证明解决范德瓦尔登数 w(2;3,21) = 416 猜想
items.title_en: Lean 4 kernel-checked proof settles van der Waerden number w(2;3,21) = 416
items.summary: A 2010 conjecture that the van der Waerden number w(2;3,21) equals 416 has been proved with a Lean 4 kernel-checked proof generated using a neuro-symbolic system and backed by a large replayable evidence package.

items.title: Binance-hacker-1029 – $5.6B stolen from Binance
items.title_zh: 币安关联钱包被盗56亿美元，引发对SAFU与稳定币冻结的激辩
items.title_en: $5.6B Binance-Linked Hack Sparks Debate on SAFU and Stablecoin Freezes
items.summary: A massive $5.6B theft attributed to Binance-linked wallets sparks debate on exchange solvency, SAFU insurance coverage, and stablecoin issuers' ability to freeze funds.

items.title: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.title_zh: Mistral 以受限“开放权重”许可发布 Mistral Large 4 模型权重
items.title_en: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4 weights under a restricted "open weight" license
items.summary: Mistral released the weights of Mistral Large 4 under a restricted license, prompting HN discussion about the misleading 'open weight' label, a steep price cut versus the preview, and real-world provider experiences.

items.title: H.264 Is Magic (2016)
items.title_zh: 《H.264 是魔法》经典编解码器深度文章再度登上 Hacker News
items.title_en: H.264 Is Magic: Classic Codec Deep-Dive Resurfaces on Hacker News
items.summary: A Hacker News discussion around the classic 'H.264 Is Magic' article, covering video compression design, x264 engineering, lossless H.264, and successors like AV1/AV2.

items.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart
items.title_zh: DoorDash 宣布收购 Instacart，美国配送市场迎来大整合
items.title_en: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart, Consolidating U.S. Delivery Market
items.summary: DoorDash announced plans to acquire Instacart, prompting discussion about antitrust, market overlap, and the impact on grocery delivery competition.

items.title: LLM Voice
items.title_zh: Martin Fowler 解析“LLM 腔调”：为何 AI 写出的文字让人读不下去
items.title_en: Martin Fowler names the "LLM Voice" that makes AI-written prose so tiring
items.summary: Martin Fowler's 'LLM Voice' examines the recognizable and wearying stylistic signature of LLM-generated writing, with HN commenters dissecting why it feels so unreadable and how it degrades human communication.

items.title: Chained PHP2Shell exploit roots 25 servers, including US Government servers
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 与 Linux XFRM 漏洞链攻陷 25 台服务器，含美国政府系统
items.title_en: Chained PHP2Shell and Linux XFRM Exploit Roots 25 Servers, Including US Government Systems
items.summary: A chained PHP2Shell plus Linux kernel XFRM ESP-in-TCP exploit compromised 25 servers, including US Government systems, sparking detailed HN discussion on kernel attack surface, exploit quality, and vendor identification.

items.title: 🛒 谷歌开放第三方安卓应用商店注册 年费 1 万美元
items.title_zh: 谷歌开放第三方安卓应用商店注册，年费 1 万美元
items.title_en: Google opens third-party Android app store registration with $10,000 annual fee
items.summary: Google has opened registration for third-party Android app stores outside the US, offering system-level install and auto-update permissions for a $10,000 annual fee starting with Android 17 QPR2 in December 2026.

items.title: ChatGPT Pro 和 Business 用户每月可领取最高 500 美元 API 额度  OpenAI 在连续 28 天更新的第 24 天更新：符合条件的

items.title_en: OpenAI gives ChatGPT Pro and Business users up to $500 in monthly API credits
items.summary: OpenAI now lets eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business users claim monthly API credits of up to $500 as part of their subscription benefits.
